question: Where’s the closest hospital located east of Moltke Maize Maze, LLC, Rogers City, MI?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois AS hospital WHERE hospital.amenity = 'hospital' AND ST_X(ST_Centroid(hospital.geometry)) > ST_X(ST_Centroid((SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Moltke Maize Maze, LLC%' LIMIT 1))) ORDER BY ST_Distance( hospital.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Moltke Maize Maze, LLC%' LIMIT 1)::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
